cases.name: every family this session left in /tmp is dropped, not just the two that were listed — the batching mark aside
cases.cmd: for p in readbounds-seen catbounds-seen diffbounds-seen knowledge-seen batching-tick runnotes implement-tdd-guard; do : > /tmp/claude-$p-{{SID}}; done; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-*-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: the per-agent suffix is dropped too — the bare session name never existed
the batching reminder's mark survives a SessionStart of the same session (compact, resume): one reminder per session
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}","source":"compact"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; rm -f /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-{{SID}}

cases.name: another session's fresh leftovers are left alone
a leftover older than two days is purged whatever session wrote it
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-old-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-old-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-old-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a family nothing registers is never touched
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a payload with no session id falls back on unknown, and cleans under that name
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-unknown-{{SID}}; printf '{}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'exit=%s kept=%s' "$?" "$(ls /tmp/claude-readbounds-seen-unknown-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
